heard: Uranus was the first new planet discovered since antiquity. Astronomer William Herschel spotted the faint world using a homemade telescope. To gain royal favor, Herschel officially named it after King George. King George III was thrilled and appointed Herschel as his royal astronomer. The king even funded a giant telescope and paid Herschel's sister. Caroline Herschel became the first woman in England to earn a scientific salary. But astronomers across the globe flatly rejected putting monarchs into space. They chose the god Uranus over a living British king.
